title: run-options
description: Options of a conductor run for one piece of work. Layers merge from the general to the specific: the [orch.conductor] configuration, the run-policy pack, the options of the phase, then the options of the item.

stages.description: Route of each role in pipeline order; a more specific layer overrides the fields of the same role.

reviewer.description: Reviewer selector PROVIDER/MODEL[/CONTEXT][/EFFORT], such as grok/grok-4.7/high.

rules.description: Short rules for the executor; layers append, a repeated rule is kept once.

items.description: One rule, a single short sentence.

skills.description: Skills to attach to roles; a more specific layer replaces the list of the role it names.

limits.description: Limits of the run of the piece of work.

instructions.description: Which instructions a role process sees; a more specific layer overrides the keys it names.

isolate_roles.description: Roles that start without the project instructions of their provider (for Claude Code: started with `--safe-mode`, so no repository CLAUDE.md, project memory, plugins, MCP servers, user skills or hooks), so that each role gets only the instructions of its own prompt. Default: every role.

checks.description: How the acceptance checks of a piece of work are run; a more specific layer overrides the keys it names.

parallel.description: Command checks that run at the same time (they must not share files); 1 to 8, default 1.

kinds.description: Kinds of checks the conductor runs in a piece of work: `["acceptance"]` is the quick pass (the gate needs evidence of the acceptance checks only), the default `["acceptance", "impact"]` the full one. Heavy repository-wide checks belong to `impact` and run in the full pass (the closing piece of a phase, or on request).

red_first.description: In a correction round the checks that were red run first; when one is still red the others are not run (a half-hour full run is not repeated for a correction that did not mend it). Default false.

executor_runs_checks.description: When false (default) the executor is told to run only the tests that cover the code it changed, because the conductor runs every acceptance check right after its report; true lets it run the checks itself.

overlap_review.description: The checks of a round run while the review of that candidate reads it; red checks drop that review and it is repeated after the correction. Default false.

review.description: How review findings are handled; a more specific layer overrides the keys it names.

correct_min_severity.description: Confirmed findings of this severity or higher are corrected; lower ones are deferred to the plan as notes for the cleanup of the phase (Blocker > Major > Minor > Nit). Default Major.

audit_scope.description: What a review round after a correction reads: `corrected` (default) only the confirmed findings of the previous round and the lines their correction touched; `full` the whole change again.

final_correction.description: On the last review round the limit allows, confirmed findings at the floor are still corrected, but no further review follows (a note in the plan says so) instead of blocking with REVIEW_LIMIT. Default false.

pre_final.description: A review round after a correction is a pre-final audit that looks only for findings of correct_min_severity or higher. Default true.

on_blocked.description: What a blocked piece of work does to the run: stop the run, or report it and go on with the next piece.

provider.description: Provider of the role, such as claude-code, codex or grok.

model_class.description: Semantic model class, resolved through the model catalog.

limits.description: Limits of the run of the piece of work.

review_rounds.description: Review rounds at most (the policy pack's max_rounds by default); 0 to 5.

corrections.description: Corrections after a confirmed review finding at most (the policy pack's max_corrections by default); 0 to 3.

check_fixes.description: Corrections after red acceptance checks at most; 0 to 3.

retries.description: Repeats of a role whose run failed or whose result is outside its contract (the policy pack's retries_budget by default); 0 to 5.

tokens_max.description: Input and output tokens of every role of the run together; 0 means no limit; 0 or more.

stage_timeout_s.description: Ceiling on the whole run of one role in seconds. 0 (default) has none for a streaming role, which is stopped by stage_idle_timeout_s instead, and keeps the launch catalog timeout for a text role; 0 or more.

stage_idle_timeout_s.description: A streaming role is stopped when its output has not grown for this many seconds (a role that keeps writing is working however long it takes); 0 switches the check off; 0 or more.

check_timeout_s.description: Timeout of one acceptance check in seconds; 1 or more.
